   **Bugs and stability.**
      14 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 20, 2026 - Nov 14, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _BlA387532_, Sep 24, 2026, 1/5: "The amount of times it glitches is absolutely uncanny. And that for 700€+ per year. Currently looking for an alternative."
            2. _Nicki Pallowit_, Nov 12, 2026, 2/5: "I like Notion’s set up and it’s pretty easy to navigate. My only issue is how buggy it gets while using it. I am constantly having to close out of and reopen the app. The cursor will be out of place, half of my notes will disappear, I will go to delete something and it will erase something on an entirely different line. The app will also randomly kick me out and delete notes."
            3. _vevenissa_, Oct 2, 2026, 2/5: "The app is absolutely amazing in itself but for god’s sake please fix the bugs. My app crashes at least once a day and I use it daily for note taking in lectures. It becomes such a hassle when the app refuses to let me type anything mid lecture and i miss very important info. I’m considering using other apps despite Notion being so handy for organization."
